title: Rain
description: A valley behind a rainy window. Drops bead, merge and run down the glass, each one holding a tiny upside-down view of the scene; drag across the fogged pane to wipe a clear streak and watch it slowly bead and fog back over.
intent: One physical surface finished to the edge: real water on real glass, where every drop is a lens and your finger is the only way to see out.
